GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transport in Animals ● Components of the human circulatory system ● The heart: s? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transport in Animals ● Components of the human circulatory system ● The heart: s.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transport in Animals ● Components of the human circulatory system ● The heart: s.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transport in Animals ● Components of the human circulatory system ● The heart: s.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transport in Animals ● Components of the human circulatory system ● The heart: s.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Salts II ● Solubility of salts in water ● Factors affecting solubility of salts ? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Salts II ● Solubility of salts in water ● Factors affecting solubility of salts .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Salts II ● Solubility of salts in water ● Factors affecting solubility of salts .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Salts II ● Solubility of salts in water ● Factors affecting solubility of salts .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Salts II ● Solubility of salts in water ● Factors affecting solubility of salts .

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and coordination ● Types of nastic responses (haptonasty, chemonasty, t? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and coordination ● Types of nastic responses (haptonasty, chemonasty, t.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and coordination ● Types of nastic responses (haptonasty, chemonasty, t.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Response and coordination ● Types of nastic responses (haptonasty, chemonasty, t.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and coordination ● Types of nastic responses (haptonasty, chemonasty, t.

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproduction.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproduction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproduction.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproduction.

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hydrocarbons ● Classification of hydrocarbons ● General formula and Nomenclature? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hydrocarbons ● Classification of hydrocarbons ● General formula and Nomenclature.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hydrocarbons ● Classification of hydrocarbons ● General formula and Nomenclature.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hydrocarbons ● Classification of hydrocarbons ● General formula and Nomenclature.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Hydrocarbons ● Classification of hydrocarbons ● General formula and Nomenclature.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Mole ● Relative Atomic Mass of elements ● Conversions of chemical quantities? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on The Mole ● Relative Atomic Mass of elements ● Conversions of chemical quantities.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Mole ● Relative Atomic Mass of elements ● Conversions of chemical quantities.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Mole ● Relative Atomic Mass of elements ● Conversions of chemical quantities.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Mole ● Relative Atomic Mass of elements ● Conversions of chemical quantities.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Gaseous Exchange in Human Beings ● Structure, functions and adaptations of the h? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Gaseous Exchange in Human Beings ● Structure, functions and adaptations of the h.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Gaseous Exchange in Human Beings ● Structure, functions and adaptations of the h.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Gaseous Exchange in Human Beings ● Structure, functions and adaptations of the h.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Gaseous Exchange in Human Beings ● Structure, functions and adaptations of the h.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Human Reproduction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Response and coordination ● Types of nastic responses (haptonasty, chemonasty, t and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
